items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: something that my brilliant voice teacher Joan Lader said to me recently

ctx.x: Did having a child affect your instrument?

Yeah. Not while I was pregnant. I sang great when I was pregnant. Even when I was nine months pregnant. I did a gig at Carnegie Hall, at the recital hall at Carnegie, a duo gig with my pianist, maybe a week or ten days before my son was born, just out to here like waddling in flats and just singing, no problem. But the problem is you have this baby in you and it’s pressing on your diaphragm and then you have the baby and all the muscles are just kind of like flabby.
